source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of low-resolution 1H NMR spectra (PDF 206-207).

blocks.text: Low-resolution 1H NMR spectrum teen ahem maloomat deta hai: molecule mein mukhtalif proton environments ki tadaad, in environments ki qismein, aur har aik mein protons ki nisbati tadaad. Teen cheezein dekhi jati hain: peaks ki kul tadaad, har peak ki jagah (us ki chemical shift) aur har peak ke neeche ka area.

items: Peaks ki tadaad mukhtalif proton environments ki tadaad ke barabar hai; har peak aik environment hai.
Har peak ki chemical shift environment ki qism dikhati hai, jo Table 30.1 se muqabla kar ke pehchani jati hai.
Har peak ke neeche ka area us peak wale protons ki tadaad ke mutanasib hai; inhein jorne se molecule ke kul protons milte hain.

blocks.text: Ethanol, CH3CH2OH, ke low-resolution spectrum mein teen peaks hain, is liye teen proton environments hain: CH3, CH2 aur OH. 5.4 ppm wali peak OH proton (kam electron density), 3.7 ppm wali oxygen ke saath CH2, aur 1.2 ppm wali methyl group hai. Peaks ke areas 1:2:3 ke tanasub mein hain, jo protons ki tadaad (OH 1, CH2 2, CH3 3) se milte hain, is liye ethanol mein 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 hydrogen atoms hain.

blocks.alt: Low-resolution spectrum: absorption of energy banam delta ppm, 7.0 se 0.0. Teen chaudi peaks: a (1H) taqreeban 5.4, b (2H) taqreeban 3.7, c (3H, sab se lambi) taqreeban 1.2, aur 0.0 par TMS ki chhoti peak. Inset mein ethanol: CH3 ke Hc aur CH2 ke Hb dabbon mein, O-H ka Ha daire (circle) mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.4: Ethanol ka low-resolution 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen peaks = teen environments. Peak a (O-H, 5.4) sab se chhoti, b (CH2, 3.7) darmiyani, c (CH3, 1.2) sab se bari: areas 1:2:3, jo har group ke protons ki tadaad hai. Dabbon aur daire ke rang peaks ke haroof se milte hain.

blocks.prompt: 1H NMR spectrum mein signals ki tadaad kya zahir karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Molecule mein mukhtalif proton environments ki tadaad.

blocks.prompt: (i) butane, (ii) propan-2-ol, (iii) pentan-3-one, (iv) benzene ke peaks ki tadaad batayein.
blocks.explanation: (i) 2; (ii) 3; (iii) 2 (do aik jaise ethyl groups ke CH3 aur CH2); (iv) 1.

blocks.prompt: Bromoethane, CH3CH2Br, ki peaks aur un ki chemical shifts batayein.
blocks.explanation: Do peaks: Br ke saath CH2 3.0-4.5 ppm par (area 2) aur CH3 alkyl had mein, Table 30.1 mein 0.5-1.5 ppm (area 3).

blocks.prompt: 2-chlorobutane kitne signals deta hai, aur kis hydrogen ki chemical shift sab se zyada hai?
blocks.explanation: Chaar (CH3-CHCl-CH2-CH3 ke chaar environments); C2 par akela H, chlorine atom ke saath, sab se zyada shift rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1H NMR spectrum mein peak area kya zahir karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Us environment mein protons ki nisbati tadaad.

items: Peaks ki tadaad = proton environments ki tadaad.
Shift = environment ki qism; area = protons ki nisbati tadaad.
